author: CNBAKid
body:
Hi! I´m GamerInfierno and I am somewhat new in Avicus. My stats are not that good because i used to play this sv when I was a real noob, then left and now I´m back :D I can play Mid or Rush And i love DTM and CTW. I can speak perfect spanish (I live in Argentina) and understandable english :P I will love to play scrimms and have a team, I practice everyday! I´m not available from 10 AM to 6 PM Argentina time (9-17 ET) But then I´m there basically all the time.

PD: Yes, I know that´s not how you spell Inferno but it´s spanish.
